other_failure_modes.name: Batch-dependent test predictions (Transductive leakage)
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies a rank transformation to the test set predictions before ensembling. This makes the prediction for any individual test sample dependent on the distribution of the entire test batch being scored, rendering the model unusable for real-time single-instance inference in production.

summary: The agent has produced an extremely high-quality solution with sophisticated feature engineering, rigorous out-of-fold target encoding, and optimal ensembling. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of loan data by using random splitting instead of an out-of-time validation strategy. Additionally, using `rankdata` on the test set predictions couples the output to the test batch size and distribution, which is an anti-pattern for production ML.
